title: ligularia carpathica
intro: Ligularia carpathica, commonly known as the 'Carpathian Ligularia', is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and acting as an antiseptic. The plant's therapeutic actions include treating conditions such as colds, fever, and digestive issues due to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenoids. These constituents contribute to the plant's antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
